segments.name: PeopleReady
segments.description: Provides clients with on-demand, contingent general and skilled labor across industries such as construction, transportation, manufacturing, retail, hospitality and energy.
segments.evidence: PeopleReady provides clients with dependable access to qualified associates for their on-demand, contingent general and skilled labor needs to supplement their permanent workforce, across a broad range of industries including construction, transportation, manufacturing, retail, hospitality and energy.

segments.name: PeopleManagement
segments.description: Provides and manages contingent associates at clients' facilities, specializing in labor-intensive manufacturing, warehousing, distribution, and commercial driver staffing.
segments.evidence: PeopleManagement provides and manages contingent associates at clients' facilities through our Staff Management | SMX ("Staff Management") and SIMOS Insourcing Solutions ("SIMOS") branded services throughout the U.S., Canada and Puerto Rico.

segments.name: PeopleSolutions
segments.description: Provides professional and specialized talent acquisition, workforce management and compliance services, including RPO, MSP and healthcare staffing, primarily in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. and Australia.
segments.evidence: PeopleSolutions provides RPO, managed service provider ("MSP") solutions and talent advisory services through our PeopleScout brand.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay TrueBlue for staffing services based on engagement scope, role and market conditions, hourly or productivity-based (cost-per-unit) pricing for industrial staffing, and per-hire fees or talent consulting fees for RPO services.
revenueModel.evidence: Pricing is typically composed of a fee for each hire and/or talent consulting fees, and is impacted by factors such as geography, volume, job type, degree of recruiting difficulty, and the scope of outsourced recruitment and employer branding services included.

changes.text: In 2025, TrueBlue acquired Healthcare Staffing Professionals, Inc., which operates within the PeopleSolutions segment.
changes.evidence: We may make additional acquisitions as part of our business strategy, such as the acquisition of Healthcare Staffing Professionals, Inc., which we announced on February 4, 2025.
